ValidationRule.description: A Rounding row exists only to make the grand total match a target value, so it must count toward the grand total, must not be folded into any group's subtotal a second time, and sits at the table level rather than under any grouping node.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Row_Type__c, "Rounding"), OR( NOT(Include_In_Grand_Total__c), Include_In_Subtotal__c, Group_Level__c <> 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Rounding row must have Include_In_Grand_Total__c = true, Include_In_Subtotal__c = false, and Group_Level__c = 0.
